design_reasoning.rationale: The project traces research constraints and multimodal alternatives into explicit route-instruction and disruption behavior.

observable_requirements.description: Compare visual, auditory, reduced-motion, low-connectivity, and cognitive-load alternatives with limitations.
Implement the selected multimodal guidance and preference boundaries without changing route facts.

architecture_maintainability.rationale: Route facts, access preferences, instruction generation, disruption policy, and semantic rendering are isolated.

observable_requirements.description: Compose normalized route facts and access preferences without coupling output channels.
Demonstrate that a presentation preference does not alter route safety facts.

security_by_design.rationale: The project minimizes saved access preferences, validates untrusted route data, and avoids exposing sensitive location history.

observable_requirements.description: Map location and access-preference sensitivity to minimization and retention boundaries.
Reject malformed route facts and unsafe external text before instruction generation.

testing_evidence.rationale: Tests cover missing landmarks, elevator outages, contradictory data, reduced motion, screen-reader ordering, and offline fallback.

observable_requirements.description: Exercise instruction ordering and content for multiple explicit access preferences.
Exercise elevator outages, missing facts, conflicting disruptions, and bounded fallback behavior.

documentation_operations.rationale: Installation, data preparation, access-preference behavior, degraded operation, and correction procedures are documented.

observable_requirements.description: Document supported access needs, input contract, output channels, and runtime non-guarantees.
Document stale-data diagnosis, outage response, correction, rollback, and recovery.

repository_hygiene.rationale: Pinned dependencies, license, CI, inclusive contribution guidance, and accessibility issue templates are committed.

observable_requirements.description: Commit deterministic dependency resolution for reproducible inspection.
Publish a recognized license granting reuse and modification rights.
Define unit and static accessibility checks without asserting runtime conformance.
Document inclusive research, review, and regression expectations for contributors.
Collect access context and impact without requiring sensitive medical disclosure.

implemented_safeguards.threat: Malformed or injected route data produces misleading or unsafe instructions.
implemented_safeguards.control: A strict validator bounds route facts, rejects external markup, and requires safety-critical fields.

implemented_safeguards.threat: Sensitive access preferences or location history are retained beyond guide generation.
implemented_safeguards.control: The guide accepts bounded preferences per request and emits no persistent identity or history fields.

negative_boundary_cases.behavior: Mark an inaccessible path unavailable and produce a bounded alternative when facts permit.
Avoid inventing landmarks and retain step ordering with explicit uncertainty.
Reject route text containing markup or unsupported executable content.

track_evidence.rationale: The product primarily improves transit autonomy for defined visual, mobility, cognitive-load, and connectivity access needs.

known_limitations.description: Static evidence cannot verify behavior with every browser and assistive-technology combination.
Generated guidance remains constrained by the accuracy and timeliness of supplied transit facts.

excluded_runtime_claims: Whether the project builds or starts
Performance, scaling, or reliability under load
Ability to extend the system safely
